description: The image displays a 2x2 grid of four pie charts representing the distribution of response categories across four different language models: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. The charts do not utilize a separate legend; instead, all category labels, raw counts, and percentages are positioned directly inside their respective slices, and no slices are visually emphasized through explosion, offsetting, or bolding. The top-left chart for GPT4-o contains two slices: a large red slice labeled "Lack of Knowledge" at 5 (83.3%) and a smaller orange slice labeled "Safety" at 1 (16.7%). The top-right chart for Gemini1.5-Pro contains five slices: "Misinformation" in orange at 33 (38.4%), "Lack of Knowledge" in dark blue at 19 (22.1%), "Ethical Advice" in light blue at 14 (16.3%), "Clarification" in pale yellow at 12 (14.0%), and "Safety" in red at 8 (9.3%). The bottom-left chart for Llama3.1-70B-Instruct consists of two slices: an orange slice for "Lack of Knowledge" at 3 (75.0%) and a red slice for "Clarification" at 1 (25.0%). Finally, the bottom-right chart for Llama3.1-405B-Instruct is divided into two equal slices: a red slice for "Misinformation" at 2 (50.0%) and an orange slice for "Lack of Knowledge" at 2 (50.0%).
